question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.
sql:
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        i.film_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue
    FROM payment p
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id
),
film_actor_count AS (
    SELECT 
        film_id,
        COUNT(*) AS actor_count
    FROM film_actor
    GROUP BY film_id
),
film_revenue_per_actor AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.actor_id,
        fa.film_id,
        fr.total_revenue / fac.actor_count AS revenue_per_actor
    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
    JOIN film_actor_count fac ON fa.film_id = fac.film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        a.actor_id,
        a.first_name,
        a.last_name,
        f.title,
        fr.total_revenue,
        ROUND(frpa.revenue_per_actor, 2) AS revenue_per_actor
    FROM film_revenue_per_actor frpa
    JOIN actor a ON frpa.actor_id = a.actor_id
    JOIN film f ON frpa.film_id = f.film_id
    JOIN film_revenue fr ON frpa.film_id = fr.film_id
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY frpa.actor_id ORDER BY frpa.revenue_per_actor DESC) <= 3
),
avg_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        ROUND(AVG(revenue_per_actor), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_actor
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY actor_id
)
SELECT 
    r.actor_id,
    r.first_name,
    r.last_name,
    r.title,
    r.total_revenue,
    r.revenue_per_actor,
    a.avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked r
JOIN avg_revenue a ON r.actor_id = a.actor_id
ORDER BY r.actor_id, r.revenue_per_actor DESC;

Lookup tables include actor, address, category, city, country, customer, film, language, staff, and store, describing entities and their attributes. The film_actor and film_category tables act as junctions linking films to actors and categories.
